**Pipeline config for issue-473 SDD run: auto mode, bounded cold-review loop**

**What**: Session pipeline config for change `issue-473-approval-signature-on-diff` (agreed with the human 2026-08-07): execution_mode=auto (all SDD phases back-to-back, show final result), artifact_store=engram, delivery_strategy=ask-on-risk, then: create PR, launch fresh-context cold-review subagent, fix rounds capped at MAX 3 (hard stop → hand to human with state), one reviewer per round (token economy, no panels). Model map: propose/design=opus, spec/tasks/apply/verify=sonnet. Strict TDD forwarded to apply/verify (runner: npm test / node --test).

**Why**: Human chose auto + PR + cold review with explicit goals: token savings and no infinite loop.

**Constraints**: any ADR/doctrine change is DRAFTED in openspec/changes/issue-473-approval-signature-on-diff/brain-drafts/ (never written to brain/** by agents); human promotes via brain:promote. Agent-authored pushes will re-arm actor-check on #473 — human must re-apply status:approved after the final push (the friction this very change fixes).

**Where**: explore phase running in background; next: propose → spec+design → tasks → workload guard → apply → verify → PR → review rounds.
